info.name: VALUM API — Project Archiving | Grupo 4
info.description: Independent HTTP acceptance tests for VALUM Group 4. Executes real requests against a locally running ASP.NET Core API and isolated SQLite database. Covers RN-01 to RN-06 integrated, RN-02 blocking and soft deletion, idempotent archive, state changes after archive, validation and project/task list filtering. RUN IN ORDER from the first item; each run creates five unique projects and does not rely on development seed. Uses collection variables g4_* to avoid namespace conflicts with Group 2/3. Never run against a production database.

exec: pm.test("PagedResult only contains archived projects; capture last page", function () { const p=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(p.pageSize).to.eql(50); pm.expect(p.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(p.totalCount).to.be.at.least(4); pm.expect(p.totalPages).to.be.at.least(1); p.items.forEach(x=>pm.expect(x.status).to.eql(1)); pm.collectionVariables.set('g4_archivedLastPage',String(p.totalPages)); });
